name: Deploy Website

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - 'site/**'
      - '.github/workflows/deploy-site.yml'
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: deploy-site
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  deploy:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: write
    steps:
      - name: Checkout main
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      - name: Setup Hugo
        uses: peaceiris/actions-hugo@2752ce1d29631191ea3f27c23495fa06139a5b78 # v3.2.1
        with:
          hugo-version: '0.123.8'
          extended: true

      - name: Build site
        run: hugo --minify --source site --destination "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/public"

      - name: Checkout gh-pages
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          ref: gh-pages
          path: gh-pages

      - name: Sync site into gh-pages (preserve package repositories)
        run: |
          cd gh-pages
          # Replace previously deployed site files, but keep the Linux
          # package repositories and the Go vendor mirror served from
          # this branch (apk/, deb/, rpm/, vendor/).
          find . -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 \
            ! -name '.git' \
            ! -name '.nojekyll' \
            ! -name 'apk' \
            ! -name 'deb' \
            ! -name 'rpm' \
            ! -name 'vendor' \
            -exec rm -rf {} +
          cp -R "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/public/." .
          touch .nojekyll

      - name: Commit and push
        run: |
          cd gh-pages
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git add -A
          git diff --staged --quiet || git commit -m "Deploy website from ${GITHUB_SHA::7}"
          git push

name: CI

permissions:
  contents: read

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

jobs:
  test:
    name: Test
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      - name: Set up Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@b7ad1dad31e06c5925ef5d2fc7ad053ef454303e # v7.0.0
        with:
          go-version-file: go.mod

      - name: Download dependencies
        run: go mod download

      - name: Run tests
        run: |
          go test -mod=mod -v -race -coverprofile=coverage.out ./...
          node --test action/test/*.test.js


  lint:
    name: Lint
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      - name: Set up Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@b7ad1dad31e06c5925ef5d2fc7ad053ef454303e # v7.0.0
        with:
          go-version-file: go.mod

      - name: Download dependencies
        run: go mod download

      - name: Run golangci-lint
        uses: golangci/golangci-lint-action@ba0d7d2ec06a0ea1cb5fa41b2e4a3ab91d21278a # v9.3.0
        with:
          version: v2.11.3
          args: --timeout=5m
          install-mode: goinstall

  vulnerability-scan:
    name: Vulnerability Scan
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Run govulncheck
        uses: golang/govulncheck-action@032d45514ae346b1db93c04b0c90b841c370344f # v1.1.0
        with:
          go-version-file: go.mod
          go-package: ./...

  build:
    name: Build
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: [test, lint, vulnerability-scan]
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      - name: Set up Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@b7ad1dad31e06c5925ef5d2fc7ad053ef454303e # v7.0.0
        with:
          go-version-file: go.mod

      - name: Verify build
        run: go build -v ./...

name: Marketplace Action Smoke Test

on:
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  smoke:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10

    steps:
      - name: Checkout release tag
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          ref: v0.5.4 # x-release-please-version
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Test successful comparison
        id: sbomlyze
        uses: ./
        with:
          sbom-path: testdata/cyclonedx-after.json
          base-sbom-path: testdata/cyclonedx-before.json
          fail-on: never
          sarif: true

      - name: Validate outputs and reports
        env:
          VERDICT: ${{ steps.sbomlyze.outputs.verdict }}
          ADDED: ${{ steps.sbomlyze.outputs['added-count'] }}
          REMOVED: ${{ steps.sbomlyze.outputs['removed-count'] }}
          CHANGED: ${{ steps.sbomlyze.outputs['changed-count'] }}
          INTEGRITY: ${{ steps.sbomlyze.outputs['integrity-drift-count'] }}
          JSON_REPORT: ${{ steps.sbomlyze.outputs['report-json'] }}
          MARKDOWN_REPORT: ${{ steps.sbomlyze.outputs['report-markdown'] }}
          SARIF_REPORT: ${{ steps.sbomlyze.outputs['report-sarif'] }}
        run: |
          test "$VERDICT" = "pass"
          test "$ADDED" = "1"
          test "$REMOVED" = "1"
          test "$CHANGED" = "1"
          test "$INTEGRITY" = "0"

          test -s "$JSON_REPORT"
          test -s "$MARKDOWN_REPORT"
          test -s "$SARIF_REPORT"

          jq -e '.diff.added | length == 1' "$JSON_REPORT"
          jq -e '.version == "2.1.0"' "$SARIF_REPORT"

      - name: Test expected integrity gate failure
        id: integrity
        continue-on-error: true
        uses: ./
        with:
          sbom-path: testdata/cyclonedx-integrity-drift.json
          base-sbom-path: testdata/cyclonedx-before.json
          fail-on: integrity-drift

      - name: Validate integrity gate
        if: always()
        env:
          OUTCOME: ${{ steps.integrity.outcome }}
          VERDICT: ${{ steps.integrity.outputs.verdict }}
          INTEGRITY: ${{ steps.integrity.outputs['integrity-drift-count'] }}
        run: |
          test "$OUTCOME" = "failure"
          test "$VERDICT" = "fail"
          test "$INTEGRITY" = "1"

name: Monthly Maintenance

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: "0 8 1 * *"
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  go-patch-update:
    name: Update Go patch release
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: write
      pull-requests: write
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      - name: Read supported Go series
        id: go-series
        run: |
          SERIES=$(awk '/^go / {split($2, v, "."); print v[1] "." v[2] ".x"}' go.mod)
          echo "series=$SERIES" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

      - name: Set up latest Go patch release
        id: setup-go
        uses: actions/setup-go@b7ad1dad31e06c5925ef5d2fc7ad053ef454303e # v7.0.0
        with:
          go-version: ${{ steps.go-series.outputs.series }}
          check-latest: true

      - name: Update Go version metadata
        env:
          GO_VERSION: ${{ steps.setup-go.outputs.go-version }}
        run: |
          go mod edit -go="$GO_VERSION"
          go mod tidy

      - name: Run race tests
        run: go test -mod=mod -race -count=1 ./...

      - name: Run govulncheck
        # govulncheck-action always installs @latest, which can require a newer Go
        # than this series; pin a release compatible with the go directive.
        run: go run golang.org/x/vuln/cmd/govulncheck@v1.7.0 ./...

      - name: Create or update maintenance PR
        uses: peter-evans/create-pull-request@5f6978faf089d4d20b00c7766989d076bb2fc7f1 # v8.1.1
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.RELEASE_PLEASE_TOKEN || github.token }}
          branch: automation/go-patch
          delete-branch: true
          commit-message: "build(deps): update Go patch toolchain"
          title: "build(deps): update Go patch toolchain"
          body: |
            Automated monthly maintenance update for the currently supported Go
            minor series. The race-enabled test suite and govulncheck passed before
            this PR was created.
          labels: dependencies

name: Release

on:
  push:
    tags:
      - "v*"
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      version:
        description: "Version to release (for example, v0.3.4)"
        required: true
        type: string

concurrency:
  group: release
  cancel-in-progress: false

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  test:
    name: Test before release
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Set up Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@b7ad1dad31e06c5925ef5d2fc7ad053ef454303e # v7.0.0
        with:
          go-version-file: go.mod

      - name: Validate requested version
        if: github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch'
        env:
          VERSION: ${{ inputs.version }}
        run: |
          if [[ ! "$VERSION" =~ ^v[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+([.-][0-9A-Za-z.-]+)?$ ]]; then
            echo "Version must be a semantic version beginning with v (for example, v0.3.4)" >&2
            exit 1
          fi
          if git rev-parse --verify --quiet "refs/tags/$VERSION" >/dev/null; then
            echo "Tag $VERSION already exists" >&2
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: Run tests
        run: |
          go test -mod=mod -v -race ./...
          node --test action/test/*.test.js

      - name: Run govulncheck
        uses: golang/govulncheck-action@032d45514ae346b1db93c04b0c90b841c370344f # v1.1.0
        with:
          repo-checkout: false
          go-version-file: go.mod
          go-package: ./...

  release:
    name: Release
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: test
    permissions:
      attestations: write
      artifact-metadata: write
      contents: write
      id-token: write
      pull-requests: write
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Set up Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@b7ad1dad31e06c5925ef5d2fc7ad053ef454303e # v7.0.0
        with:
          go-version-file: go.mod

      - name: Create release tag
        if: github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch'
        env:
          VERSION: ${{ inputs.version }}
        run: |
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git tag -a "$VERSION" -m "Release $VERSION"
          git push origin "$VERSION"

      - name: Install Syft
        uses: anchore/sbom-action/download-syft@3ad7283483fc7af8ff2b4ea19663c2d5ca935e26 # v0.24.2

      - name: Run GoReleaser
        uses: goreleaser/goreleaser-action@f06c13b6b1a9625abc9e6e439d9c05a8f2190e94 # v7.2.3
        with:
          distribution: goreleaser
          version: "~> v2"
          args: release --clean
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          HOMEBREW_TAP_GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.HOMEBREW_TAP_GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Attest release artifacts
        id: attest
        uses: actions/attest@1e69f48acb82d1966a394da916b4c1698aa569d6 # v4.2.2
        with:
          subject-checksums: dist/checksums.txt

      # Scorecard's Signed-Releases check only sees signatures attached as
      # release assets, not the GitHub attestation store.
      - name: Upload attestation bundle to release
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          BUNDLE: ${{ steps.attest.outputs.bundle-path }}
          TAG: ${{ inputs.version || github.ref_name }}
        run: |
          cp "$BUNDLE" "sbomlyze_${TAG#v}_attestation.sigstore.json"
          gh release upload "$TAG" "sbomlyze_${TAG#v}_attestation.sigstore.json" --clobber

      # release-please runs with skip-github-release, so it never marks its
      # merged release PR as tagged and refuses to open the next one.
      - name: Mark release PR as tagged
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          TAG: ${{ inputs.version || github.ref_name }}
        run: |
          prs=$(gh pr list --state merged --label "autorelease: pending" \
            --search "\"release ${TAG#v}\" in:title" --json number --jq '.[].number')
          if [ -z "$prs" ]; then
            echo "No pending release PR found for $TAG"
            exit 0
          fi
          for pr in $prs; do
            gh pr edit "$pr" --remove-label "autorelease: pending" --add-label "autorelease: tagged"
          done

name: Prepare Release PR

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  release-pr:
    name: Prepare release PR
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: write
      pull-requests: write
    steps:
      - name: Create or update release PR
        uses: googleapis/release-please-action@45996ed1f6d02564a971a2fa1b5860e934307cf7 # v5.0.0
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.RELEASE_PLEASE_TOKEN || github.token }}
          config-file: release-please-config.json
          manifest-file: .release-please-manifest.json
          skip-github-release: true

  # Merging a release PR bumps the manifest version. When that version has no
  # tag yet, start the Release workflow, which tags, builds and publishes it.
  publish:
    name: Publish merged release
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: release-pr
    permissions:
      actions: write
      contents: read
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Start release for untagged version
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          GH_REPO: ${{ github.repository }}
        run: |
          VERSION="v$(jq -r '."."' .release-please-manifest.json)"
          if git ls-remote --exit-code --tags origin "refs/tags/$VERSION" >/dev/null; then
            echo "$VERSION is already tagged; nothing to release"
            exit 0
          fi
          echo "Starting release $VERSION"
          gh workflow run release.yml --ref main -f version="$VERSION"

name: Sync Website Version

on:
  release:
    types: [published]
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      version:
        description: 'Release tag to sync (e.g., v0.5.4)'
        required: true

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  sync:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: write
      pull-requests: write
      actions: write
    steps:
      - name: Checkout main
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          ref: main
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Resolve release tag and commit
        id: rel
        run: |
          if [ "${{ github.event_name }}" = "release" ]; then
            TAG="${{ github.event.release.tag_name }}"
          else
            TAG="${{ github.event.inputs.version }}"
          fi
          git fetch --tags --quiet
          SHA=$(git rev-list -n1 "$TAG")
          echo "tag=$TAG" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "sha=$SHA" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "Syncing site to $TAG ($SHA)"

      - name: Update site/hugo.toml
        id: bump
        run: |
          TAG='${{ steps.rel.outputs.tag }}'
          SHA='${{ steps.rel.outputs.sha }}'
          sed -i -E "s|^(  version = )\".*\"|\1\"$TAG\"|" site/hugo.toml
          sed -i -E "s|^(  actionSha = )\".*\"|\1\"$SHA\"|" site/hugo.toml
          if git diff --quiet -- site/hugo.toml; then
            echo "changed=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "site/hugo.toml already up to date"
          else
            echo "changed=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            git diff -- site/hugo.toml
          fi

      - name: Open and merge pull request
        if: steps.bump.outputs.changed == 'true'
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          TAG='${{ steps.rel.outputs.tag }}'
          BRANCH="site/sync-$TAG"
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git checkout -b "$BRANCH"
          git commit -am "chore(site): sync website version to $TAG"
          git push -u origin "$BRANCH" --force
          gh pr create --base main --head "$BRANCH" \
            --title "chore(site): sync website version to $TAG" \
            --body "Automated update of \`params.version\` and \`params.actionSha\` in site/hugo.toml for $TAG."
          # Branch protection requires a PR but zero approvals, so the
          # workflow can merge its own PR once GitHub reports it mergeable.
          for i in 1 2 3 4 5; do
            if gh pr merge "$BRANCH" --squash --delete-branch; then
              exit 0
            fi
            echo "Merge not ready yet, retrying ($i/5)..."
            sleep 10
          done
          echo "Failed to merge PR after retries" >&2
          exit 1

      # A merge performed with GITHUB_TOKEN does not emit a push event that
      # other workflows can react to, so trigger the deploy explicitly.
      - name: Trigger website deploy
        if: steps.bump.outputs.changed == 'true'
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: gh workflow run deploy-site.yml --ref main

name: OpenSSF Scorecard
on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 6 * * 1'
  push:
    branches: [main]
permissions: read-all
jobs:
  analysis:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      security-events: write
      id-token: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: ossf/scorecard-action@2d1146689b8cda280b9bc96326124645441f03bc # v2.4.4
        with:
          results_file: results.sarif
          publish_results: true
      - uses: github/codeql-action/upload-sarif@2892aa5e19bbd11bc0cff5427e3b750a04d9e3c2 # v4.38.2
        with:
          sarif_file: results.sarif

name: Update Package Repository

on:
  release:
    types: [published]
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      version:
        description: 'Version to add (e.g., 0.2.0)'
        required: true

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  update-repo:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: write
      pages: write
    steps:
      - name: Checkout gh-pages branch
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          ref: gh-pages
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Get version
        id: version
        run: |
          if [ "${{ github.event_name }}" = "release" ]; then
            VERSION="${{ github.event.release.tag_name }}"
          else
            VERSION="v${{ github.event.inputs.version }}"
          fi
          VERSION="${VERSION#v}"
          echo "version=$VERSION" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "Processing version: $VERSION"

      - name: Install tools
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y dpkg-dev rpm createrepo-c

      - name: Download release assets
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          VERSION="${{ steps.version.outputs.version }}"
          echo "Downloading packages for version $VERSION..."

          mkdir -p downloads
          cd downloads

          # Download all .deb, .rpm, .apk files
          gh release download "v$VERSION" \
            --repo ${{ github.repository }} \
            --pattern "*.deb" \
            --pattern "*.rpm" \
            --pattern "*.apk" || true

          ls -la

      - name: Update APT repository (Debian/Ubuntu)
        run: |
          VERSION="${{ steps.version.outputs.version }}"

          # Create directory structure
          mkdir -p deb/pool/main
          mkdir -p deb/dists/stable/main/binary-amd64
          mkdir -p deb/dists/stable/main/binary-arm64
          mkdir -p deb/dists/stable/main/binary-i386

          # Copy new packages
          cp downloads/*.deb deb/pool/main/ 2>/dev/null || true

          # Generate Packages files for each architecture
          cd deb

          for arch in amd64 arm64 i386; do
            # Map i386 to 386 for package naming
            if [ "$arch" = "i386" ]; then
              pattern="386"
            elif [ "$arch" = "amd64" ]; then
              pattern="amd64"
            else
              pattern="$arch"
            fi

            dpkg-scanpackages --arch $arch pool/main > dists/stable/main/binary-$arch/Packages 2>/dev/null || true
            gzip -9 -k -f dists/stable/main/binary-$arch/Packages
          done

          # Generate Release file
          cd dists/stable
          cat > Release << EOF
          Origin: sbomlyze
          Label: sbomlyze
          Suite: stable
          Codename: stable
          Architectures: amd64 arm64 i386
          Components: main
          Description: sbomlyze package repository
          Date: $(date -Ru)
          EOF

          # Add checksums
          {
            echo "MD5Sum:"
            find main -type f | while read file; do
              echo " $(md5sum "$file" | cut -d' ' -f1) $(wc -c < "$file") $file"
            done
            echo "SHA256:"
            find main -type f | while read file; do
              echo " $(sha256sum "$file" | cut -d' ' -f1) $(wc -c < "$file") $file"
            done
          } >> Release

          cd ../../..
          echo "APT repository updated"

      - name: Update YUM/DNF repository (RHEL/Fedora)
        run: |
          VERSION="${{ steps.version.outputs.version }}"

          # Create directory structure
          mkdir -p rpm/packages

          # Copy new packages
          cp downloads/*.rpm rpm/packages/ 2>/dev/null || true

          # Generate repository metadata
          cd rpm
          createrepo_c packages/
          cd ..

          echo "YUM repository updated"

      - name: Update APK repository (Alpine)
        run: |
          VERSION="${{ steps.version.outputs.version }}"

          # Create directory structure for each architecture
          mkdir -p apk/packages/x86_64
          mkdir -p apk/packages/aarch64
          mkdir -p apk/packages/x86

          # Copy packages to appropriate directories
          for f in downloads/*_amd64.apk downloads/*_x86_64.apk; do
            [ -f "$f" ] && cp "$f" apk/packages/x86_64/ 2>/dev/null || true
          done
          for f in downloads/*_arm64.apk downloads/*_aarch64.apk; do
            [ -f "$f" ] && cp "$f" apk/packages/aarch64/ 2>/dev/null || true
          done
          for f in downloads/*_386.apk downloads/*_x86.apk; do
            [ -f "$f" ] && cp "$f" apk/packages/x86/ 2>/dev/null || true
          done

          # Generate APKINDEX for each architecture
          # Note: Proper signing requires a key, using unsigned for now
          for arch in x86_64 aarch64 x86; do
            if [ -n "$(ls -A apk/packages/$arch/*.apk 2>/dev/null)" ]; then
              cd apk/packages/$arch
              # Create simple index (unsigned)
              tar -czf APKINDEX.tar.gz *.apk 2>/dev/null || true
              cd ../../..
            fi
          done

          echo "APK repository updated"

      # index.html and all other site files on gh-pages are owned by the
      # Deploy Website workflow (Hugo build from site/ on main). This job
      # only touches the package repository directories.

      - name: Commit and push
        run: |
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"

          git add -A
          git diff --staged --quiet || git commit -m "Update package repository for v${{ steps.version.outputs.version }}"
          git push
